niche: Mind Hacks, AI Secrets, Bizarre Body Science & Hidden Power Dynamics

ideas.title: The Red Hammer Brain Glitch
ideas.angle: An interactive mental challenge where the narrator forces the viewer to think of a specific object and color through rapid-fire math. The reveal at the end causes massive comment engagement as viewers confirm if it worked or share their 'glitched' alternative.

hook.en: I'm going to read your mind.

ideas.reason: Interactive mind-reading tests have the highest VVSA because they require immediate participation. The 'Red Hammer' effect is a classic psychological priming trick that consistently goes viral by proving how predictable human heuristics are.
sources: Scientific American: The Science of Mind Reading Tricks

ideas.title: The Reverse Favor Power Move
ideas.angle: A social power dynamic video explaining why asking for a small favor makes someone like you more than if you did a favor for them. It challenges the viewer to try it today and comment 'it worked' once they see the shift in respect.
ideas.reason: Counter-intuitive social advice triggers curiosity. The Ben Franklin Effect is a well-documented cognitive dissonance phenomenon that provides high-value 'social survival' knowledge, driving high APV and shares.
sources: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology

ideas.title: The Audio Illusion That Breaks Your Brain
ideas.angle: A live interactive test using the McGurk Effect where the viewer hears a different sound depending on whether their eyes are open or closed. This forces the viewer to rewatch the video multiple times to 'test' their ears, skyrocketing the APV over 100%.
ideas.reason: Sensory illusions are the 'gold standard' for 100%+ APV because viewers must loop the video to verify the effect. This specific glitch proves how your vision overrides your hearing, creating a high 'shock' factor.
sources: Nature: The McGurk Effect in Speech Perception
BBC Science: How Your Eyes Can Fool Your Ears
